sample_face.jpg is a resized copy of DeepFace's MIT-licensed unit fixture:
https://github.com/serengil/deepface/blob/master/tests/unit/dataset/img1.jpg

face_too_dark.jpg / face_too_bright.jpg are synthetic luminance variants of
sample_face.jpg (scripts/make_lighting_fixtures.py) for C2 quality-gate tests.

face_pad_print.jpg / face_pad_replay.jpg are synthetic print / screen-replay
proxies (scripts/make_pad_fixtures.py) for C3 PAD tests.

face_occluded_mask.jpg is a synthetic surgical-mask occlusion proxy
(scripts/make_occlusion_fixtures.py) for C5 PPE/occlusion tests.
They are not biometric enrollment samples.
